This data set contains the metadata for the one hundred and twenty-six (126) files (.tif, .tfw) that create the orthomosaic image of Turner Valley Gas Plant. These images were collected with a DJI Phantom 4 Pro UAV and Pix4D Capture and processed with Pix4Dmapper 4.3.33 by Geomatics Engineering students at the School of Construction, Southern Alberta Institute of Technology.
